subject: c-cont
title: TRS.------C.CONT.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-35, first of two on book p179, on the page where Braxton argues that 'to view the vibrational and actual realness of western culture is to view non-white people as only supporting players — whose contributions, no matter how vast, do not really figure in the defining and controlling scheme that determines how events are to be culturally perceived.' TRS (transition) is crossed with C-CONT (composite continuance); the arrow points to C-CONT, which is the subject: the question is what composite continuance produces when crossed with transition under the conditions of western cultural curation Braxton has just described. DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) branches from the main line and carries INFO-DE (information degrees), which carries PRO-CONT (progressional continuance). PRO-CONT carries RE-ST (restructuralism), S-SH (source shift), which carries VT-DY (vibrational dynamics), and (P)DOC (documentation, at the point of idea completion); T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) branches from (P)DOC and carries RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits).
